title: Positive-degree Ext into an injective object vanishes
statement: Let C be an abelian category with small Ext groups [def-sp-abelian], X an object, and I an injective object [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. For every n≥0, Extⁿ⁺¹(X,I) is a subsingleton, hence its only element is zero.
